messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: If you have an adrenal gland problem, you will need to start treatment with a steroid (glucocorticoid) medicine before you start levothyroxine. Starting levothyroxine first can trigger a sudden, serious drop in adrenal hormones known as an adrenal crisis.
Older adults and people with heart disease are usually started on a lower dose, because too much thyroid hormone can cause an irregular heartbeat (most commonly atrial fibrillation), angina, or other heart problems. Tell your doctor if you develop chest pain, breathlessness, or a fast or irregular heartbeat.
Taking more levothyroxine than your body needs over a long period can weaken your bones and lead to a higher risk of fractures. This is more likely after menopause. Your doctor will aim to give you the lowest dose that controls your thyroid levels.
Oral levothyroxine should not be used to treat myxedema coma. Levothyroxine given into a vein is used instead.
Triplet: ["levothyroxine", "has goal", "lowest dose that controls thyroid levels"]

The relation 'has goal' in the triplet is defined as 'The treatment with the subject drug aims to achieve the outcome or therapeutic target specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has mechanism of action': The subject drug produces its therapeutic effect through the biological mechanism specified by the object entity.
B. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
D. 'belongs to drug class': The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
E. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
